test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_bf_dynamic (j JSON) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS index_granularity_bytes = 0
ALTER TABLE json_bf_dynamic ADD INDEX bf j TYPE jsonbf_v1() GRANULARITY 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_bf_dynamic SELECT concat('{{"integer":', toString(number), ',"string":"value-', toString(number), '","mixed":', multiIf(number % 3 = 0, toString(number), number % 3 = 1, toString(toUInt64(9223372036854775808) + number), concat(toString(number), '.5')), '}}')::JSON FROM numbers(1000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM json_bf_dynamic WHERE j.integer = {missing} SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {use_index}
SELECT count() FROM json_bf_dynamic WHERE j.integer = '{missing}' SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {use_index}
SELECT count() FROM json_bf_dynamic WHERE j.string = 'value-{missing}' SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {use_index}
SELECT count() FROM json_bf_dynamic WHERE j.mixed = {missing} SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {use_index}
SELECT count() FROM json_bf_dynamic WHERE j.mixed = '{missing}' SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {use_index}
SELECT count() FROM json_bf_dynamic WHERE j.mixed = 500001 SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {use_index}
SELECT count() FROM json_bf_dynamic WHERE j.mixed = '500001' SETTINGS use_skip_indexes = {use_index}
